prose: Reuters reports that drones hit a data center owned by Yandex, Russia's leading AI and technology company, in the town of Sasovo, the first major attack on a Russian data hub since the Ukraine war began. Yandex said so on Thursday.
Only the Techmeme excerpt was reviewed, so damage, service impact and attribution are not given.
highlights: Drones struck a Yandex data center in Sasovo
First major attack on a Russian data hub since the war began
Damage and attribution not in the excerpt
